name: Unusual Suspects
summary: Cooperative deduction where a silent witness answers yes/no to quirky questions to help detectives identify the hidden culprit among twelve.
rules_text: Setup 12 random suspect portraits in a 3x4 grid. One player is the Witness and secretly draws a card indicating which position is the Guilty Party. Others are Detectives. Shuffle question cards face down. Each round up to 11: a Detective draws and reads a question card. The Witness must answer only Yes or No by placing the card under a Yes/No marker, based on their subjective interpretation of the guilty portrait, without talking or gesturing. Detectives then discuss publicly and must eliminate at least one suspect they think does not fit the answer, by majority agreement, turning innocent suspects face down. If they eliminate the guilty suspect, all lose immediately. Otherwise record how many were eliminated this round and multiply by round number for time penalty. Continue until all 11 innocents are eliminated and only guilty remains, then all win with lowest time being better.
rating_reason: Witness vs detectives deduction with hidden role and talk
